pgCapture.note: zero-cache maintains a read-only replica of Postgres from logical replication and uses the existing schema.

partialSync.note: Synced queries in ZQL; the server decides which rows a client may see per query.

offlineWrites.note: HARD FAIL for PaperOS: 'Zero doesn't support offline writes' and Zero 'is not local-first. It's a client-server system with an authoritative server.' Writes are rejected while disconnected (only briefly queued during reconnect).

permissions.note: 'Zero does not have (or need) a first-class permission system like RLS'; permissions are filter-based checks inside server-side query and mutator handlers. Clean, but a third policy home beside RLS and can().

bundle.note: Client reported at 718 kB raw / 232 kB gzipped; no WASM, backed by IndexedDB.

targets.note: TypeScript/web only (no native mobile SDK), which suits Tauri; IndexedDB persistence has the same Tauri reset caveat.

selfHostLicence.note: Apache-2.0 and self-hostable, but adds a stateful replica service with its own disk to the VPS budget; hosted SaaS is invite-only.

maturity.note: 1.0 on 2026-06-08 after ~2 years; 1.9.0 by 2026-08-14. Single vendor, actively developed. Recommends datasets under ~100 GB.

ergonomics.note: Best-in-class DX: typed ZQL, reactive queries, custom mutators.

exit.note: ZQL queries and custom mutators permeate client and server; leaving Zero is a rewrite of the read and write layers.
